title: One RAG request: search, filter by permission, then answer with citations
captions: The question goes to an embedding model. It turns the text into a vector, a long list of numbers that captures its meaning.
Vector search finds the 3 stored chunks whose vectors are nearest to the question. One of them is an internal note for staff.
A permission filter checks each chunk against what this user may read. The user is a customer, so the staff note is dropped before the model ever sees it.
The app builds the prompt. It holds the rules, the question and the 2 allowed chunks, each with a number the model can cite.
The model answers from the 2 chunks and cites them. The user can open [1] and [2] to check the answer against the real policy.
